src/shell-init.ts.name: Offered services list
src/shell-init.ts.description: Builds the list of protocol areas and services a napplet is told about, counting only those whose host hooks are really wired, narrowed by any per-napplet host grant; also reports whether an area still needs setup.

src/shell-ready.ts.name: Ready reply
src/shell-ready.ts.description: Answers a napplet's ready message once with its services and records its trusted identity and grants.
